check.title: Check a message
check.intro: Paste text, a link, a screenshot, or a voice clip. Klaro checks any sender it names against the Bank of Mauritius registry snapshot and tells you what it finds — a checkable fact, not a guess.
check.attachLabel: Attach a screenshot or voice clip
check.messagePlaceholder: Paste the SMS, email or WhatsApp text here…
check.composerHint: Paste a message or link, or use + to attach a screenshot or voice clip.
check.urlHint: Klaro fetches the page's text content and checks it the same way as pasted text. It never visits a private or internal address.
check.imageHint: Klaro reads the text out of the image locally (OCR) before checking it — nothing is sent to a third party.
check.audioHint: Transcribed locally with an offline speech recognition engine. Accuracy is lower than typed text, especially for brand or institution names — Klaro will flag this in the result and show you exactly what it heard so you can double-check it.
check.saveCheckbox: Save this check to my history. Turn this off if the message contains an OTP, account number, or anything you'd rather Klaro never store.
check.resultEmpty: Your result will appear here — a verdict stamp, the registry match, and why.
check.notSaved: Not saved — this check isn't in your history.
check.responsibleUse: A registry match confirms a claimed sender's name is in a dated snapshot — it doesn't confirm the message itself is genuine. A sender that isn't found isn't proof of fraud either; many legitimate senders sit outside this registry entirely. Before sending money or sharing credentials, verify through the institution's own official channels, never a number or link inside the message you're checking.

insightPanel.stayAwareBody: Genuine banks never ask you to share an OTP, PIN, or full card number over SMS, email, or WhatsApp. If a message pressures you to act immediately, that urgency is itself a warning sign — slow down and verify independently.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every check you've chosen to save, most recent first.
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Checks you save from Home will show up here in your history.

insights.title: Insights
insights.intro: A quick rollup of your own check history.
insights.feedbackSummary: You've rated {{count}} verdict(s): <bold>{{correct}}</bold> marked correct, <bold>{{incorrect}}</bold> marked incorrect.

safe.label: Verified
safe.detail: The claimed sender's name matches an entity in the Bank of Mauritius registry snapshot. This confirms the name is genuinely registered — it does not confirm this specific message was sent by them. Always reach the institution through its own official channels before acting.

suspicious.label: Unverified
suspicious.summary: Not found, or only a close match
suspicious.detail: No exact match was found in the registry, or the name is only a close (not exact) match to a registered entity. This isn't proof of fraud — many legitimate senders simply sit outside this registry — but it means the name couldn't be confirmed, so treat it with extra caution.

high_risk.label: High risk
high_risk.detail: The claimed sender's name resembles a registered institution closely enough to suggest deliberate impersonation, without being an exact match. This is the strongest warning sign Klaro can surface — avoid clicking links, sharing OTPs, or sending money until you've verified through the institution's own official channels.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Manage your account, sessions, and stored data.
settings.aiKeyDesc: Optional, for when the AI language-pattern layer is wired in. Stored encrypted; never shown again in full.
settings.sessionsDesc: Sign every device with a token for your account out at once, including this one.
settings.deleteDesc: Permanently deletes your account, saved checks, and activity log. This can't be undone.
